headline: Simply Piano rebuilt its funnel for parents buying for a child, and Learna switched to a $1 7-day trial. Breeze lowered its smallest trial amount to $0.99.

what_changed.imprint: No screen changes. The ad link to start-history was removed; this run’s start-buddhism quiz stopped before the paywall (see Coverage).
what_changed.breeze: Paywall: the smallest “choose any amount” option is now $0.99 instead of $1, and the “No charge on this page” small print is gone.
what_changed.simply-piano: Funnel rebuilt for parents: every question now asks about the child (age, experience, how they learn); about 20 adult-learner screens removed. Paywall unchanged.
what_changed.memoryos: No changes (only the paywall timer differs). 1 funnel link removed (mos_cfg=read003b).
what_changed.chillio: Paywall unchanged; support email moved to your-chillio.com, matching its new funnel address. 1 new funnel link (nutrition-ai).
what_changed.learna: Paywall rebuilt: $1 for a 7-day trial, then $19.99/month, plus 3- and 6-month plans (was 1 week $10 / 1 month $30 / 1 year $100). One work question reworded.
what_changed.copymind: No changes (only the paywall timer differs).
what_changed.simply-sing: No screen changes; the walk still stops at its voice test. Ad link to the singyourheartout page removed.
what_changed.yousician: Paywall captured for the first time after a test sign-up: 7-day free trial, then $159.99/year ($13.33/month). New ad link to yousician.com.
what_changed.smartyme: No screen changes. Ads: 64 new in two weeks.
what_changed.skillsta-vocal-2: No screen changes. After the email code our test lands on /quiz/standard-rate/new_vocal, which shows the quiz’s first screen again.
what_changed.skillsta-vocal-scanner: No screen changes. After the email code our test lands on a blank screen.
what_changed.skillsta-drawing: No screen changes. After the email code our test lands on /quiz/standard-rate/drawing, which shows the quiz’s first screen again.

screens.title: Smallest trial amount lowered to $0.99
notes: The lowest “choose any amount” option is now $0.99 instead of $1; $2, $10 and $17.34 stay.
The small print “No charge on this page… Please review conditions at the next screen” was removed; the line “It costs us $17.34 to provide this trial offer…” is back in its place.

notes: The lowest “choose any amount” option is now $0.99 instead of $1; $2, $10 and $17.34 stay.

screens.title: Paywall unchanged; support email moved to your-chillio.com
notes: Plans and prices are the same (1-week trial $10.50, 4 weeks $19.99, 12 weeks $34.99, all 50% off).
Only the support address in the terms changed from support@my-chillio.com to support@your-chillio.com, matching the funnel’s new your-chillio.com address.

screens.title: Paywall unchanged; support email moved to your-chillio.com
notes: Plans and prices are the same (1-week trial $10.50, 4 weeks $19.99, 12 weeks $34.99, all 50% off).
Only the support address in the terms changed from support@my-chillio.com to support@your-chillio.com, matching the funnel’s new your-chillio.com address.

screens.title: Opening question now speaks to parents
notes: Same question, “What motivates you to play the piano?”, with answers reworded for a parent choosing for a child.

screens.title: New: “What is your child’s age?”
notes: The funnel now asks about the child instead of the user (“What is your age?” is gone).
From here on every question is about the child: previous experience, favourite styles, how they learn, how involved the parent wants to be.

From here on every question is about the child: previous experience, favourite styles, how they learn, how involved the parent wants to be.

screens.title: Work question reworded
notes: “What kind of work do you do?” has a different set of answers; the follow-up now asks about a role in education instead of business or management.

screens.title: Follow-up now about education
notes: “What best describes your current role in education?” replaces “What’s your main area in business or management?”.

screens.title: Paywall switched to a $1 trial
notes: Was: 1 week $10, 1 month $30, 1 year $100 (60% off), billed weekly at $24.99 after the first week.
Now: “7 Days Full Access” for $1.00, then $19.99 per month; 3 months $11.66/mo and 6 months $10.00/mo (60% off).

screens.title: Sign-up before the paywall
notes: “Create your account” comes right before the paywall; our test account used that run’s plus-address.

screens.title: Paywall captured for the first time
notes: “Start your 7-day free trial”: Yearly plan $13.33/month ($159.99/year), “Save 50%”; card form, PayPal and Google Pay on the same screen.

ideas.title: Test a $1 7-day trial as the default plan on the Vocal 2.0 and Drawing paywalls.
ideas.detail: Should move Paywall → Purchase, which fell to 18.5% in Vocal 2.0 (from 25%) and 12.5% in Drawing (from 25.5%).

ideas.title: Check what Vocal 2.0 and Drawing show right after the email code.
ideas.detail: In our test the code led back to the quiz start (/quiz/standard-rate/…). If real users see the same, it would explain Email → Paywall of 29% and 23% against 99% in the Scanner.

ideas.title: Test a “for my child” branch at the start of the Drawing quiz.
ideas.detail: Simply Piano now builds the whole quiz around the child, and Simply Draw already targets kids.
